deadline.value: Apply by March 31 for September entry to be considered for UVic Fellowships. The regular September deadline is August 1.
deadline.quote: You must apply by March 31 for September entry to be guaranteed consideration for University of Victoria Fellowships.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must list a potential supervisor who agrees to be your supervisor and recommend your admission.
supervisor.quote: This faculty member must agree to be your supervisor and recommend your admission.

funding.value: All students in the program receive financial support; the minimum yearly stipend was $26,000 as of 2022/23.
funding.quote: All students in this program receive financial support.

also.quote: As of 2022/23, the minimum yearly stipend is $26,000

entry_route.value: The master's must be in a field related to biochemistry (or microbiology for the microbiology PhD).
entry_route.quote: Your master’s degree must be in a field related to biochemistry.

also.quote: Your master’s degree must be in a field related to microbiology.

notes: One record covers the Biochemistry (PhD) and Microbiology (PhD) programs from the Molecular Life Sciences department, which share deadlines, supervisor and funding rules. Mapped to biomedical sciences as an interpretation: the page covers pathogenesis, immunology and vaccines. Biology PhD is saved separately.
